reviews.text: Ellison pet hospital is the best took my Frenchie in there to get neutered he needed surgery and they fixed his nose so he could breathe easier, and the price wasn’t bad. I recommend this place to everyone.
Clean/ Fast. Pricey
Mr. Joe does an excellent job grooming my babes.

I want to thank Dr Lorie Curd and her wonderful Team Members for taking excellent care of my Rescue Pit, Faith.  They always provide loving, comforting treatment and always make her feel cared for. She is so comfortable that when Ava is behind the desk, she attempts to run to her just for a kind word or pat. She really thinks her appointments are play dates.
Dr Curd is not only a great doctor but so innovative, and keeps up on all the newest treatments and procedures. She provides anything from well checks to intensive care, and  more invasive therapies. She has provided my Faith with oral surgery, to abdominal leison removals and tumor removals to, axilla lymph node removal. She always takes the time to explain all reports and consultations, and the various options. I recommend this Clinic to all who care about their fur babies. This team is the best and I have visited here for the last 20 years off and on and feel Faith is getting the best care possible. Thank you to all....by the way Faith has a consultation with the Oncologist at the Cancer Center...thanks to you all...hopefully everything was caught early or the earliest as possible. We'll keep you mind with the results...Faith need
We love to bring our dogs here for grooming services. Joe is amazing at his job. We drop them off at 8am and by 10:30 they are usually done! We think prices are reasonably.
Thanks you for taking care of coalx!😀 …
They were very friendly and respectful. The pricing wasn't too bad either. Will continue to keep bringing my pup here

Let's start when I first took my babies to this place they were nice but after a while they showed their true colors this people don't care about your pet all they care is making money off you some doctors are over worked one time the doctor was falling asleep while explaining what my dog had I even asked him if he was ok he said I been working over time this place don't diagnose your pet with the right problem but the reason is so you can come back and spend more money and one time they cut my girl Sandy nails and they said they nipped one then she started limping I called to report this they said they would call but they never did like I said please don't take your pet here unless you willing to spend your money on something that will never help your pet all you be doing is just giving your money away now I usually take me pets to Becker animal hospital on I 10  they always do a better job I know it's a little expensive but you know you won't be taking your pet again over and over like Ellison drive animal hospital so stop wasting your money and don't trust this veterinarian I'm sorry to say this but is true and this is why they are loosing customers according to a worker like I said my pet Bear they diagnosed him with the wrong Diagnosis I spent over 400 but when I took him to Becker animal hospital they told me it was cussing and in 2 months he started get better his hair grew and was himself again so please if you care about your pet don't bring them here
Very affordable boarding.

I've never had much of a problem at this place until now. I called in last Tuesday to get a refill for my dog Piper's Atopica. Something we have been told she has to take every day for the rest of her life.
Called back Friday, because no one had contacted us and we had run out.
Was told that someone had put the request at the bottom of the pile, misplaced it, whatever. Was told that my only alternative was to schedule an appointment today at 5:10p.m. to get blood work drawn.
Show up today and the young lady at the front desk (with a snarky attitude) told me that I was being uncooperative on Friday and the appointment was never made.
We are at about $13,000 into this dog with her initial treatment and twice yearly blood work. Plus the medicine.
We love this dog and will pay whatever we need to pay to keep her healthy and alive. But if I am paying this much money for what we consider a family member then don't be surprised when I get upset that the front desk people misplace requests. And the attitude is definitely not needed.
Would love to talk to a manager if possible.  Shouldn't be difficult to figure out who my dog is.
Everyone was nice and took great care of my kitten, answered all my questions and made me feel comfortable with the care they qere giving my baby kitten
The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They seem to really care about the animals.
Was told something and called again to ask if they would take the animal and was not told the same thing from first time called
Very helpful and polite. They handled my pitbull very nicely. My dogs are shy and a little reactive but they were very gentle and understanding.
Everyone at this vet clinic was very nice and informative. We are very comfortable here and know our pets are receiving quality care.
Thank you for the compassionate care of my Big Boy Chico !
Friendly, understanding, and affordable

Be careful and think twice when coming here to do ANY kind of surgical procedure. I recently took my dog here to have her "Tooth" extract.(prior to this, I was told they would only extract the affected tooth) fast forward a few weeks i was given a few estimates that seems to go up on price everytime I ask for an estimate about the procedure. And then comes the day of the surgery. I expected to pay the estimated cost that they send over email.....no they immediately charged me the high end amd were VERY VAGUE about what actually goes in that would cost nearly 2k. What's crazy is that they also added a 50 dollar charge for a medicine that I was never told about till last minute. The head doctor also told me that I HAD  a choice to pay for either the low end or the high end. But when THAT NEVER happened. And so when I called back to speak about the cost since there is a 150 dollar deposit (that was never shown in the invoice). The lady over the phone started blaming me for the fact that I paid nearly 2k amd blamed me for accepting the medication where they never gave me a choice in the first place. OH not to mentioned that they nearly took out all her teeth without making it known to me unless I CALLED THEM. I had to call to get updates even though they expressed that they will keep me in the loop. I'm transferring my pet and all the Info to another hospital...where I hear and seen that they treat people better.
Things went really well!!!  God Bless 🙌 🙏 ✨️
Very polite to my precious girl! Exceptional service 🙏🏽 I highly recommend to bring your pets in for their needs.
Friendly, helpful staff. Very accommodating, great with the animals.

Why did I have to pay up front for the service. I paid an amount when I got there and paid again when I left. Like they did not trust me!!! I ASK TO SEE THE VET AND TOLD BECAUSE I DROPPED PRECIOUS OFF IN THE MORNING. I COULD NOT SEE THE THE VET...I REALLY THINK YOU ARE OVER PRICED...
Thank y’all for helping my baby have a comfortable finale.
Took great care of my cat. She had been missing for 40 days and was in critical condition and she is healing greatly now.

I was impressed with the cleanliness of your business. Everyone is friendly and polite. Very professional. The care my dog received was wonderful and made me feel like she was in good hands. Prices were a bit high especially for folks on a fixed income. Prices are crazy now. The amount I paid for my dog's care is more than half of what I get once a month. Thank God for my roommate.
Very helpful with my dog and very nice people
Everyone was very kind and helpful.  Marley will definitely go back again and again.

I arrived at the vet with a hurt dog. They were unable to help me due to not having a vet at the time but the receptionist saw i was panic and very quickly came to my car with a list of vets in the area and helped talk me through what I should do for my dog. I wish I got her name but she even got me tissues and came back when I teared up. This place hires people who took great care of me even when there was nothing they could do to help me. I can only speak for the receptionist but whoever is hiring made a very great choice!!
Great staff and super friendly! Definitely recommend bringing your pets here!

Usually people judge my husband because of the Tattoos... the staff was friendly and understanding... we have 2 more fur babies at home... we will definitely make this our vet... so close to home which is great because one of our dogs gets motion sick... and their OPEN on Saturdays...Pretty Boy said thanks for the medicated shampoo and flea medicine!!! Thank Y'all for everything super happy with the service we received!!!

Was quoted incorrect price before initial visit. The reception staff is not very good at returning calls/texts. If you want a prescription filled, it will be a long time with no communication in between. This place needs to do better. I've been to other vets in the San Antonio area who are more attentive and upfront. I will be going elsewhere from now on. TRUST the reviews!
Always takes care of Draco and love the groomer!

We’ve been going to Ellison Drive Animal Hospital for over 20 years for all our pet medical needs. They are great to work with from beginning through end of life care. They listen and care about my pets, currently two cats and a dog
Excellent services very happy 😀😀👍🙄 …

Amazing patient service. Both of my dogs love it here. One struggles with a chronic illness and the other only has annual visits. All team members are kind, caring and compassionate. I am so thankful to this vet office for consistently providing an excellent experience. It is refreshing to walk into an atmosphere that is warm and welcoming, especially during difficult times as a pet parent.

My Dane broke his tail as soon as I moved to San Antonio. The staff here did an amazing job diagnosing and developing a care plan for him. They are communicative, caring and understanding. They showed a lot of patience in dealing with testy behavior from both my dog and myself, lol. Presley's surgery went extremely well and he had clean stitches and no infection. Overall an excellent experience for what started as a traumatic one. Ill be taking him here for regular care from now on as my dog trusts them and so do I. Highly recommend 👌
They gave my dog furosemide in 2024 and it killed her. I read the side effects and my dog had all of the symptoms.
They have taken great care of our cat and dog. Also they send friendly reminders of when your pet needs to be seen.
I always bring my pets to Ellison drive for medical treatment as well as the grooming service and my pets always receive top notch care!!! Would definitely recommend.

I was a bit iffy about trying this place because of the reviews, but it was closer than his usual vet. Since there was a lot of negativity around money and price gouging, I asked for a quote over the phone for a rabbit nail trim, and they said $25-30. It was a little more pricey than expected, but because of the distance, I made the appointment and drove up. Then it was $51. So i left.

No one told me you have to prepay the max amount once you arrive. Tying up hundreds of dollars with no notice whatsoever for a week with no heads up is ridiculous.  Its very simple to let people know when scheduling

Review in ENGLISH ESPAÑOL FRANCAISE

The staff was rude, cold, and uncompassionate from the start.

Will tell you your pet looks better, charge you, and if they die even the same day you visited, they will not give refund. Very traumatic. Don’t go here

The first initial visit went amazing. I feel like they took really good care of my 3 animals....at the time. Fast forward to 5 days after the visit, I called them to move forward on a prescription we were given for my oldest dog for his arthritis. I have now called them about 6 times now and every time they tell me no one can talk to me and they will give me a call back...which they have yet to get back to me. Our initial visit was on 9/22. It is now 10/21 and I have yet to receive a call back. When it comes to my dogs, they are like my children, there is no sense of urgency with this vet clinic so I will be taking them somewhere else.

Thank you for the wonderful review! We’re so grateful for your support and for allowing us to care for your pet. Our team takes great pride in providing a positive experience for both pets and their families, and we’re thrilled to hear that came through during your visit. We can’t wait to see you again! 🐾 …
Excellent care..
Very friendly and great customer service

Today we had to put down our Obi. To my surprise it felt like a peaceful letting go. The  doctor is amazing. You can see that the doc is very compassionate with her animals and their owners. We won't go anywhere else. We love you doc and staff

Love this hospital clinic!!!!! The doctor and staff did a tremendous job on my dog. Just had my daughter's cat put down😔😔 but my goodness the way everything was handled was by far done with perfection and very professional!!! …

I went to this animal and an angel fell from the sky watched over our dog gizmo and this angel become the doctor who saved him from torn hernia he was Torn  inside his stomach his guts was outside his stomach but it wasn’t spilling literally The docter had to put him to sleep for the surgery. There was a chance that he wouldn’t wake up from the anesthesia, but that angel that is the doctor in disguise is Dr.Curd that saved his life we think her so much and her staff-Mary Ann Rutten

The most distinguishing characteristic about a Frenchie is their ears. Unfortunately, my Frenchie has been experiencing some major bacteria/yeast infections in both of his ears and it got to the point where it was affecting his hearing. I would clean his ears and within 2/3 days they were once again full of a black waxy gunk. Now it’s been a few weeks since Dr Curd examined Ammo and started a treatment plan for him. I’m so glad to see his ears stay clean and he is back to waking up with every little sound.

Had to take my dog here and let me be the one to congratulate a job well done. A special applause for vet tech Crystal who handled my dog Bella so well and who was extremely professional. It was all because of her exceptional experience with dogs that showed up when she took care of Bella. The cost was extremely affordable and I will definitely be back, hopefully just for preventative maintenance.

I have been bringing my dog to Ellison Drive Animal Hospital for years, but after our most recent experience, I will not be returning. I truly hope other pet owners think twice before trusting their animals with the individuals at this clinic.

Last week, my dog injured one of his nails when it got caught in the carpet while he was running up the stairs. It was cracked, bleeding, and clearly causing him pain. I called the clinic and was scheduled for an appointment. When we arrived, I pointed out the exact nail that was injured and it was still visibly damaged and had dried blood on it. I was told they would trim the nail, wrap his paw, and send us home with medication. The visit cost close to $200.

Since my family was going out of town the next day, we chose to leave the bandage on for the full week. We wanted to be cautious, especially because my dog tends to lick his paws and has a habit of removing bandages on his own. His sitter followed all the instructions and gave him his medication regularly.

When I returned and finally removed the cast, I was shocked. The injured nail I had specifically pointed out was still there, untouched. Instead, they had cut off a completely different nail.

I called the clinic immediately, hoping they would instantly acknowledge the mistake and offer to correct it. Instead, I was met with a dismissive attitude and told I would have to pay a starting fee of $65 to be seen again, not including any other necessary costs.

It was only when we went up to the clinic in person and pushed the issue that they finally agreed not to charge us to fix their mistake. During that conversation, they deflected and claimed the nail they trimmed had been hanging off and had discharge, which is completely false. My family and I know without a doubt that the nail they cut was completely fine and showed no signs of injury.

I understand that mistakes can happen, but what frustrated me most was the lack of accountability. I showed them the correct nail, and it was still visibly injured and clearly bothering my dog. There should have been no confusion. Instead of immediately acknowledging the mistake and working to fix it, I found myself having to repeatedly explain what went wrong while they stayed defensive and avoided taking responsibility. Rather than owning their mistake, they tried to shift the blame onto us for not removing the cast sooner, even though we were simply trying to protect the injury from infection while we were away.

After being a loyal client for years, I am incredibly disappointed. If something this basic can be handled so carelessly, I would never feel comfortable trusting them with a more serious issue. I will not be returning, and I strongly recommend finding a clinic that treats both pets and their owners with the care and respect they deserve.

TLDR; employees were high and I have never had an on time appointment here.

I have taken my cats here about 3 times, and the appointment has never actually been at the time that they told us it would be. One of my cats has to take anxiety medication prior to his appointments, and it wears off quickly (and costs me money). Because they are never on time, his medicine wears off and he is unable to be seen.
The last time I took him, I was the first appointment of the day. They told me they were still prepping the rooms for animals to be seen, so I agreed to sit in my car and wait for someone to either call me or wave for me to come in. I waited 45 minutes and then went in to check, as his medication was wearing off. The employees were visibly high, and literally told me that they forgot about us.

We have been going to Ellison Drive Animal Hospital for years. Everyone that we have encountered that works there is friendly and professional. The front office is always so welcoming, and the vets have been knowledgeable and compassionate. We have taken all 3 of our dogs there, and they have received excellent care. We not only trust them with our dogs' health, but with their grooming and boarding needs as well. My experience with Ellison Drive Animal Hospital has been wonderful.

I would first like to say the front desk and the techs are absolutely wonderful very caring and sweet.
I have been bringing my cat to Ellison since she was a baby.  She was a bottle fed kitten and the Dr. at that time fixed my Spookee up and she has been great ever since . I have brought her in 8 times since 2019 for physicals and when she was not feeling good.. The Vets and staff have all been great.
Till 6/2/25 vet Sreenvasa Donapaty saw Spookee He was very uncaring and had the nerve to ask"well what is wrong with her exactly".  He couldn't see that she was Dizzy and falling over . After blood tests and letting me know we need to run more tests.  Being $350 in and not having a clue what's wrong with her .
He gave me a options and I answered well right now what does she need the most and then I can come back for the rest .. and he said whatever you think ...I don't know that's why I'm here ..So I had to guess and pay more , not knowing really what was wrong unless I paid another $300 for further test.  Yes I understand vet bills are not cheap, but it was the part of my cat just being another animal that made me feel like he really wasn't trying to help .
My cat does need to go back and I hoping I get another Vet .  Like  I said Ellison has been great with Spookee till now .

I just wanted to say that Veronica the Vet tech was the sweetest person there, She and the other staff were so kind and made our whole time there very comfortable as we said our goodbyes to my sweet fur baby Daisee, I was very nervous to have her last moments at the vet office as she’s always been very anxious but my sweet girl was so relaxed and it made me feel grateful that she went to sleep in such peace. So thank you Veronica for guiding us and being so sweet and comforting to my Daisee Mae.

If only there is a Zero I would put it instead of the 1 star! I brought my adult yorkie today as his tongue was bleeding and after i put in pressure and ice i took him to vet. I understand that we were walk-in and tech saw my yorkie, even cane in the 2nd time to clean him, said he may need his tongue cauterized, etc but she will ask the doctor. Of course I understood that it has to be doctor’s recommendation and not the tech,  I do not remember his name but sounded like an Indian name, he was very unfriendly, uncaring,  and did not provide further recommendation, his only purpose was he told me he could not do anything as they are short staffed, and to make appointment for Monday. He even told me that he is the doctor and the tech has no certification. Why put down a coworker, just for him to stress out who he is?  He needs to learn bedside manners as our pets are family members too. He should have taken care of this better so as not to ignite this type of review.

He said my dog’s tongue is not actively bleeding , as i said i did already what i think could b done and tech somewhat cleaned out the blood already, duh! Very unprofessional doctor i encountered on  4/26/25 around 11 to 11:30 am. I know he had to triage in situations like this and moment i transported my dog his tongue was bleeding bad in my car t lots of blood droplets. We waited already for like an hour as we arrived a little past 10 am as i recall. Definitely not going back to this place, no wonder google reviews are  unsatisfactory!

almost 3000.00 for a dental for a 9 pound dog. doctor said 1500.00, said estimate in 15 minutes,  took 2 weeks and estimate was doubled. my eye surgery wasn't that much. incompetent tech i had to tell I had already paid for labs and antibiotics.  they are out of their collective minds.

Place is very over priced and adds costs that don’t make sense. I took my small chihuahua in to get put down due to being attacked that morning. My dog weigh about 10 lbs maybe 13 lbs at most. They charged me close to $600 to euthanize him. I have called other places now getting quotes for that same size and euthanize for $150. They will take advantage of you in times of need and will gladly up the bill if you’re willing to pay. DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOG HERE!

I used to love this vet but I am transferring all of my animals to another vet. The vet and her assistant are either too busy for the patients or they simply don't care. My rabbit died in my arms today while I waited for the results of an x-ray that was taken Thursday of last week. I still haven't heard back about the X-ray and I paid a lot to have it done. I am disappointed in this location and simply can't understand why they keep taking new patients if they don't have the time for them.

I went to Vanguard got got for my money told me nothing was wrong but I knew better so couple days later took him here and they let me know right away he had a double ear infection they also helped treat him for h his seizures and he went to having several a day to it's been over a week since I've noticed him having one thank you all

My spoiled brat got parvo last year and we took him to Ellison. Because it was cheaper we decided to take him home & try admin. meds ourselves. We'll that didn't go well so ellison worked out a day to day taking him in process with us and within 2 days he was starting to get back to his old self. I love, love, love the staff at this place. Always helpful, informative and willing to work with you. Now let me say almost Everything is on the pricey side but I guess that's what it cost now to have a fur ball part of ur family. 🐶🐱
They are like family to me.  They were always kind and understanding about my sweet dog.

Routine, scheduled visit for cat. The front desk was friendly and helpful. The vet tech was also knowledgeable and reviewed costs associated with visit. Dr. Hale - great bedside manner, funny.  Hope the clinic had a good day.

Our usual vet we like to come to, but it's becoming unaffordable. They wouldn't let us check out without charging for a rabies vaccine. She's already had it that year but without papers they charged us for it and did it again.
Very reasonable pet hospital, nice attentive doctors not willing just to run you for your money.

Our dog snapped her tooth shortly before new years. We took her in and confirmed she needed to have the root extracted. They issued no pain meds and said they would contact us with an estimate.

After a week we had received no estimate despite me calling 3 different times. They finally sent me an email and said they would not be issuing any estimates until their surgeon was back from vacation in 3-4 weeks.

Why was I not told up front so I could make other arrangements? How are you a "hospital" if you don't have surgical capability for over a month?

I asked for our pets records so I could find a new vet. They responded 2 days later with an estimate and claimed they could get her in in 2 days.

The estimate was a complete joke. 1600 to extract one tooth. 2k if I wanted her to have IV fluids and such during the procedure. I'll post a screenshot of the estimate.

This is extremely typical of this place unfortunately. They constantly nickel and dime everything after making us wait forever and then never letting us talk or ask questions. We have been fighting for weeks to get our cat a simple arthritis shot. Their sister clinic, Potranco Veterinary Clinic, is just as bad.

I took my dog to Animal Hospital of Westover Hills, got in immediately, got an estimate for 500 with only 5 line items on it, and a surgery date 2 days out. Will be transferring our other 4 pets there if the experience is good.

This place was originally recommended to me a year ago and since taking my dog there, I've discovered they aren't much different than VCA or Banfield when it comes to being driven by money. Every time I've taken my dog in for his Cytopoint shot, the price of it has fluctuated dramatically. In fact, it's the same for almost anything I've had done there. There is no transparency in pricing and it seems like they just charge whatever they feel like. A blood test a few months ago was $77 but just recently they tried to charge $176 for the same test and upsell me on a more advanced test just shy of $400 just to renew apoquel. They also insisted on my dog continuing to take cytopoint shots after I informed them the last two had zero effect on him. It's more about "how can we maximize how much money we can get out of this pet owner?" as opposed to personalized care that actually works. On to look for another vet that actually provides personalized care and transparency in pricing.
DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS HERE!!!! Horrible vet. Horrible boarding.

BEWARE, DO NOT TAKE YOUR ANIMALS HERE. Took my dog to get a minor surgery done. Upon arrival Tech lead Jody weighs my dog at 69lbs and provides us with the price breakdown. Having us pay the cost up front. The doctor (Dr. Lori Curd) calls me 8hrs later- she proceeds to tell me that Jody weighed my dog wrong and he was now 75lbs which caused them to use more of everything meaning a higher cost. Also, that Jody misquoted us and removed required supplies from the quote which she now needed to add back, raising the cost. We explained to her that if our dog had needed additional unforeseen treatment, we would have gladly covered the costs. But these costs, that were due to staff negligence and a tech lead (which he emphasized) at that; should not be cost that we incur. They should honor the quoted costs. Dr. Curd then proceeds to unprofessionally accuse us of not being able to afford having our dog, threatening to not return our dog and ends it with saying she doesn’t want customers like us. The irony is, when I go to pick up my dog, the receipt says my dog weighed 69lbs at the conclusion of surgery. Even after having paid and receiving my receipt they are still trying to call me for more money! I would never let them touch my animals ever again much less try price gouging me for their incompetent staff. Not to take away from the very sweet front staff that does their best provide excellent customer service.

They took amazing care of my dog Layla and did everything they could to make the cost reduced for what needed to be done for her. They always explained what was going on as well.
My dog loves the people there even though they had to run weekly bloodwork on her. She would actually wag her tail and speed up towards the door when we got there.
Excellent vets, vet techs, receptionists, and everyone else here!

Terrible vet! Took my elderly dog in and they did the bare minimum to try and figure out what was wrong. She would have suffered and died at home if we didn’t take her to another place that actually did their job!! She unfortunately passed but wasn’t in pain thanks to the other vet.  I would not bring your dog here.

Joe is a great groomer. He has cleaned up my  dog's coat several times.  Prices are good and work is quick as well.  Mr Phoenix is happy. Staff is personable  service seems to be good across the board.

Ellison Drive Animal Hospital is a wonderful place to take your pet.  Reception is friendly. Martin, the technician, was kind and provided the best education, and Dr. Cousins was so friendly and kind.  We will definitely be going back, and we highly recommend!
This is our second time taking my nieces dog to this location we have never had a problem with them the vet and staff took good care of my niece's dog.
Excellent service at the Potranco location.  Ava Silva is the BEST!

I brought my GS for quarentine services to the clinic. I'm so happy that I found this place. I've received a prompt and professional service. My dog is not friendly, but  I was amazed to see how the techs were able to handle him without fear, and without a muzzle right away. Charges wise, they were very transparent, no surprises for me. They informed and asked me first about his vaccines. I would definitely come back here to board him again.

My wife took one of our pups here today because he’s been sick and their Potranco location saw him on the first emergency visit we needed. Our normal vet was booked and busy (now we understand why). The Potranco location was lovely, sweet people, very understanding and our pup did so good during his visit. This location couldnt be further from that. My wife took our pup in for the same issue he’s had since the first visit 2 weeks ago so to say we were stressed is an understatement. The vet Lori couldn’t help but talk behind what I guess she thought was a sound proof door about how bad we are as parents because our dog isn’t neutered, and he’s behind on his shots. We weren’t there because he’s not neutered so I don’t understand their concern regarding that. We tried to get him up to date on his shots the last visit but he was sick so they said it had to wait but he wasnt in dire need because he’s not a social guy. Regardless, your job is to help animals and provide important information to their owners, not bad mouth someone who is trusting you in a time of need. Next and probably the biggest issue was when Lori came in to tell my wife the treatment options. I wasn’t there in the office but on the phone with my wife while she was there because she was so upset about the comments she heard from the back.
